key_insight: The paper turns nonlinear aggregation-diffusion PDE solving into a variationally trained neural transport problem, where a neural velocity field drives the density through a continuity equation.
engineering_relevance: This offers a mesh-free framework for simulating complex transport phenomena in chemotaxis, polymer dynamics, and related PDE-driven systems.
method: Use Onsager’s variational principle to rewrite the PDE as a constrained optimal control problem.
Parameterize the transport velocity with a neural network and train it on variational losses along particle trajectories.
Propagate density and generalized score equations together with an Euler time-stepping scheme to evaluate the objective efficiently.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical experiments on several representative models and a rigorous error analysis with bounds for approximation, optimization, Monte Carlo sampling, and time-discretization errors.
watch_item: Accuracy depends on balancing multiple error sources, so training stability and discretization choices may strongly affect performance.
paper_title: Variational neural transport for aggregation-diffusion equations
